feat: strengthen online Intent, Scope, and Recovery agents for web app

- Richer Gemini prompts for the three core features
- Scope receives commit diffs when available
- Auto-derive task from latest commit message when user leaves task empty
- Clearer recovery and final report structure for dashboard display
- .env.example documents online (USE_GEMINI_ANALYSIS=true) setup
